# Freedom Holding Corp. Ranks Top-17 Out of 410 Investment Banking & Investment Services companies in LSEG’s ESG Ranking


[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_29936fe3511ec5825384acd8f94d33b1/freedomholdingcorp/news/2026-11-24_Freedom_Holding_Corp_Ranks_Top_17_Out_of_410_126.pdf) November 24, 2026


Freedom Holding Corp. received an **LSEG ESG Score of 3.5** , ranking 17th among 410 companies in LSEG’s Investment Banking & Investment Services category. London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) is a global provider of financial markets data and infrastructure. Its ESG assessment evaluates companies’ management of material sustainability risks and opportunities.


The rater has acknowledged the Company’s top-tier practices in tax transparency, business ethics and anti-corruption, awarding Freedom Holding Corp. with the highest grade possible. Freedom Holding Corp.’s approach toward human rights management and the Company’s proactive involvement in the development of local communities has deserved high notable recognition as well. The Company also demonstrated consistent improvement of its environmental impacts monitoring alongside with climate risk management.


**Freedom Holding Corp.’s FY2026 Sustainability Report is available on the Company’s**[ESG for Investors page.](https://ir.freedomholdingcorp.com/esg-for-investors)
